entry.title: The week in free proxies: Nov 16 – Nov 23, 2026
entry.content:
6,954 different type://ip:port entries passed every check at least once (many are ports on the same host). Of the 5,896 that left the list again, 91 % were not on the next list. None of them had been on it for 24 runs in a row (about a day).
In the last run Google let 56 % of the 241 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 17 % of datacenter exits, 67 % of the other exits.
In the last run Reddit let 84 % of the 233 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 42 % of datacenter exits, 97 % of the other exits.
In the last run Amazon let 45 % of the 255 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 38 % of datacenter exits, 47 % of the other exits.
In the last run Instagram let 45 % of the 229 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 18 % of datacenter exits, 54 % of the other exits.
In the last run TikTok let 73 % of the 215 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 83 % of datacenter exits, 70 % of the other exits.
In the last run Discord let 100 % of the 229 HTTPS-capable proxies that gave a clear answer through – 98 % of datacenter exits, 100 % of the other exits.
Between 541 and 1,645 entries were on the list at any one time. Right now: 883, 52 % of them tunnel HTTPS to the test host, 23 % are datacenter exits (the provider name looks like a hosting company).
Downloading 100 KB through the HTTPS-capable ones, counting the downloads that finished: half manage 83 KiB/s or more, the fastest tenth over 162 KiB/s.
Most exit IPs are in United States (155), Indonesia (58), Netherlands (51), Russia (47), China (38).
